House of Ming — Taj Mansingh, New Delhi (2018).

An art programme for the Taj’s Chinese room: its symbols restated, not quoted. A moon gate as a circular passage; the mystic knot set as a filter against ill fortune; cages that ask whether they enslave or protect; an “incomplete” screen that keeps only what holds; a giant Ming plate, fragmented and re-set.

Artwork & installation — Anirudh Kapoor. A·01
